summary: Discord music session state (now playing, paused, volume, which channels) now persists in Postgres, not just the upcoming queue -- groundwork for surviving a restart.
details: New music_session table, one row per guild, upserted on every play/pause/resume/volume-change/track-advance, deleted on /music stop.

This is stage 1 (write-through) only -- Nora does not yet reconnect and resume sessions on boot. A restart still drops active sessions exactly as before; the state to resume FROM now survives it, ready for a follow-up to read.
limitations: Playback position within a track is never persisted or resumed -- only which track, paused-or-not, volume, and which channels.
Boot-time auto-resume is not built yet (design/discord-music/06-session-persistence.md's stage 2).
